notes: E18 is the key: re-probing the same x values gives different outputs (e.g. x=-0.5 → 8.20, 8.63, 8.51; x=0.3 → 6.06, 6.78, 4.16), so the residual is **noise**, not a deterministic oscillation. The old chirp/sine model was fitting noise. I replaced it with base 16.8·|x| plus a near-zero mean residual (tiny slow wobble as a guess at the mean), which is the best deterministic predictor of a noisy quan
